_about: Defaults RightTon applies when a house file leaves an input out. Each default has its source and a confidence flag, and every default that was applied is listed in the results so the user can see which numbers the answer rests on.

heating_setpoint_f.source: OpenStudio-HPXML defaults.rb (commit fb18723): indoor heating design temperature

cooling_setpoint_f.source: OpenStudio-HPXML defaults.rb (commit fb18723): indoor cooling design temperature

cooling_indoor_humidity_frac.applies_when: no cooling_indoor_humidity_frac; 0.45 is used instead where outdoor design air is drier than indoor air
cooling_indoor_humidity_frac.source: OpenStudio-HPXML defaults.rb (commit fb18723): 50 % indoor relative humidity, 45 % in dry-summer climates

ground_conductivity_btu_hr_ft_f.source: OpenStudio-HPXML defaults.rb (commit fb18723) / hvac_sizing.rb: heavy moist soil, R-1.25 per ft, used when the soil type is unknown

ceiling_height_ft.source: OpenStudio-HPXML defaults.rb (commit fb18723): average ceiling height

house_internal_sensible_gain_btu_hr.applies_when: no room has internal_sensible_gain_btu_hr; shared among rooms by floor area
house_internal_sensible_gain_btu_hr.source: OpenStudio-HPXML defaults.rb (commit fb18723): appliance and lighting gain for a house with one refrigerator

occupant_count_from_bedrooms.applies_when: no room has occupant_count and project.bedroom_count is given; shared among rooms by floor area
occupant_count_from_bedrooms.source: OpenStudio-HPXML defaults.rb (commit fb18723): number of bedrooms plus one

occupant_count.applies_when: no room has occupant_count and project.bedroom_count is not given; shared among rooms by floor area
occupant_count.source: RightTon choice: the three-bedroom case of the rule above

shielding_class.source: OpenStudio-HPXML defaults.rb (commit fb18723): infiltration shielding class for a typical suburban site

interior_shading_coefficient.source: RightTon choice: no credit for blinds or curtains unless they are described (the cautious direction for cooling load)

solar_absorptance_frac.applies_when: a wall assembly has no solar_absorptance_frac

foundation_wall_thickness_in.applies_when: a foundation wall has no thickness_in

heating_airflow_cfm_per_ton.applies_when: an hvac system gives no heating airflow

cooling_airflow_cfm_per_ton.applies_when: an hvac system gives no cooling airflow

duct_supply_area_per_floor_area.unit: ft2 of duct per ft2 of floor served
duct_supply_area_per_floor_area.applies_when: a supply duct segment has share_of_ducts_frac instead of surface_area_ft2
duct_supply_area_per_floor_area.source: OpenStudio-HPXML defaults.rb (commit fb18723) get_duct_surface_area, based on ASHRAE Standard 152

duct_return_area_per_floor_area_per_retu.unit: ft2 of duct per ft2 of floor served, per return grille (at most 0.25)
duct_return_area_per_floor_area_per_retu.applies_when: a return duct segment has share_of_ducts_frac instead of surface_area_ft2
duct_return_area_per_floor_area_per_retu.source: OpenStudio-HPXML defaults.rb (commit fb18723) get_duct_surface_area, based on ASHRAE Standard 152

duct_rectangular_fraction.unit: fraction of duct length that is rectangular
duct_rectangular_fraction.applies_when: a duct segment gives insulation_r_value_hr_ft2_f_btu (nominal) instead of an effective R-value

vented_attic_vent_area_frac.unit: ft2 of vent per ft2 of attic floor
vented_attic_vent_area_frac.applies_when: a vented attic has no vent_area_per_floor_area_frac

vented_crawlspace_vent_area_frac.unit: ft2 of vent per ft2 of crawlspace floor
vented_crawlspace_vent_area_frac.applies_when: a vented crawlspace has no vent_area_per_floor_area_frac

space_height_ft.applies_when: a space has no volume_ft3: volume = floor area of its slab or floor x this height (attics: footprint x height / 3 from roof pitch)
